speaker_role: current admissions officer (Chico State/CSU Chico admissions counselors, live Q&A)
key_insights: For fall 2021 admission, Chico State (part of the CSU system) did not require SAT/ACT scores; officers noted this policy could change for fall 2022 and beyond.

Transfer applicants do not need a completed Associate's degree (AA/ADT) to be admitted; the actual requirement is 60 transferable units including 30 GE units and four specific 'golden four' GE courses.

Application fee is $70 per CSU campus, with fee waivers available for qualifying students (covering up to four campus applications); families whose financial situation changed can contact admissions for a manual exception.
First-time freshman and transfer applicants must submit an initial transcript copy by February 12 and a final official copy by July 15 (for the cited fall term).

Transfer coursework in progress or planned is acceptable at application time, but all requirements must be completed by the prior spring (for fall admission) or prior fall (for spring admission); summer/winter coursework does not count toward the admission deadline requirement.
Support resources include the Student Learning Center (tutoring, math lab, writing center) and the Accessibility Resource Center (exam accommodations, note-takers, mobility assistance, interpreters).
Officers describe an honors college/GE honors track plus separate major-specific honors requirements that vary by department (project- and/or GPA-based).
specific_numbers_or_facts: Application deadline extended from December 4 to December 15 (stated as a same-day update during the livestream, for the CSU system generally).
Application fee: $70 per campus; fee waiver covers up to 4 campuses.
Transcript deadlines: initial copy by February 12, final official copy by July 15, for fall 2021.
Transfer admission requirement: 60+ transferable semester units, including 30 GE units and the 'golden four' GE courses.
About 10% of the student population participates in Greek life; campus has 200+ recognized student organizations.
Chico is located about 90 miles north of Sacramento; roughly 7-8 hours' drive from the Los Angeles metro area.
notable_or_distinctive: Real-time, campus-specific procedural details (fee waiver exception process, exact transcript deadlines, transfer unit/GE requirements) straight from admissions staff rather than general admissions theory.
reliability_notes: Video is 5 years old (per manifest) and policies are explicitly tied to 'fall 2021'/'fall 2022 and beyond' framing (e.g., the test-optional policy), so figures like deadlines, fees, and testing requirements are very likely outdated and should be reverified against current Chico State/CSU policy.
